title: Brain scoring API v2 — server-side embedding (SERVED)
description: Chunk TEXT + structural features + graph metadata in, quantized keep/cut scores out. v2 is brain-api/v1 with exactly three substitutions — emb_text/emb_cmd/emb_head become text/cmd/head, task_emb becomes task_text, sys_emb becomes sys_text, tool.emb becomes tool.schema_text — and nothing else changed. The embedder moved off the user's machine into the brain (DIRECTION.md §5 rev. 2026-07-20, docs/server-side-embedding.md), so the client no longer ships an ONNX model; it still chunks, computes node_struct_with_type(21), the 49-col readout, and the rel-4 supersession pairs locally, because the freezer needs the chunk set to decide what to drop. NOTE the deliberate departure from v1: raw text IS representable here. v1 remains SERVED and is the contract for deployments that require text never to leave the machine. The checkpoint_id matched-pair guard (§8.2) is retained in full — that is the reason v2 derives from v1 rather than from brain-api-dev/v0, which has no such guard and additionally makes the server re-chunk. Scores ride the 1e-6 fixed-point grid (engine SCORE_SCALE).

grid_q.description: fixed-point score on the 1e-6 grid (engine SCORE_SCALE): q = round(sigmoid * 1_000_000)

gf.description: doom-head run-state input, CLIENT-computed loop_feats over the conversation's ACTION stream: [current loop fraction, trailing-3 mean, slope over 3 steps, trailing-6 fraction >= 0.34]. Slope can be negative. Omitted = doom not scored.

checkpoint_id.description: sha256 of the checkpoint .pt the client featurized against; the brain 409s on mismatch with its loaded bundle (§8.2 matched-pair trap: features and weights must move together). Retained verbatim from v1 — this guard is the reason v2 is not a promotion of brain-api-dev/v0.

ident.description: bounded identifier charset (conv_id, tool name — harness identifiers)

hex16_id.description: salted 16-hex identity hash. Retained from v1 unchanged: these are the graph's identity/hub keys (equality and truthiness are what ride), and keeping them client-computed keeps graph construction byte-identical to v1. On v2 they are no longer a privacy mechanism — the text they name rides alongside — but they remain the join keys, so do NOT derive them server-side.

text2000.description: chunk/task/system text, CLIENT-truncated to 2000 characters before send. The client truncates (not the server) so the wire stays small and the truncation point is identical to v1's pre-embedding clip — the vectors the server produces must match what v1's client-side embedder would have produced from the same clip.

text240.description: observation head, CLIENT-truncated to 240 characters — the same clip v1 applied before embedding, and the same string head_id salts.

node.description: one live chunk. Identical to the v1 node except the three embedding slots carry text instead of vectors; the server embeds them and then rebuilds the exact same graph. EMPTY-STRING SEMANTICS ARE LOAD-BEARING: an empty cmd/head must produce a ZERO VECTOR server-side, not the embedding of the empty string — v1's client mirrored this (featurize::vec_or_zeros never called the embedder on ""), and the parity gate pins it.

text.description: chunk text[:2000] — xe content slot + rel-2 kNN cosine

cmd.description: the producing command, UNTRUNCATED (v1 embedded it untruncated; the clip would change the vector). Empty string when the chunk has none (cmd_id null) -> server emits a zero vector.

head.description: observation head[:240]. Empty string when none (head_id null) -> server emits a zero vector.

struct.description: node_struct_with_type row: struct_features_causal(16) + struct_type_features(5), still computed client-side — the freezer already has the chunk set and the causal history

tokens.description: chunk token weight (max(1, len(text)//4)); the trace forward reads token mass from `struct`, not from this field

file_id.description: salted hash of the file basename; null = fileless chunk (no rel-0 chain edge, no file hub)

lo.description: first original-file line covered; null disables the rel-0 chain for this chunk

cmd_id.description: salted hash of the producing command string; null = no command (no command hub row)

head_id.description: salted hash of the observation head[:240]; PRESENCE is the has-head marker and gates the head hub on the command's first chunk

name.description: tool name — the keep-set filter's join key back to the request roster

schema_text.description: the serialized schema json.dumps({name, description, parameters}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True); the server embeds it. v1 sent the embedding of this exact string.

tokens.description: len(serialized schema)//4 — the mass unit prune() ranks on; echoed back aligned with scores_q

score_trace_request.description: POST /v1/score/trace with contract='brain-api/v2'. The server embeds nodes[].text/cmd/head + task_text/sys_text, then runs the IDENTICAL v1 graph build and score_decided path — score-identical to v1 on the same conversation, pinned by the cross-contract parity gate.

target_cov.description: accepted for provenance; tau resolves at bundle load (DASEIN_TARGET_COV), not per request

nodes.description: the LIVE chunk set (client registries applied) in decision order — the stable step-sorted parse order; the temporal chain i->i+1 and all equal-step tie-breaks key on this ordering

task_text.description: the task statement (first user message) text[:2000]; empty string when absent -> zero vector

sys_text.description: system prompt text[:2000] (the harness hub payload); omitted or empty = zeros

mask.description: rows of `nodes` to decide (undecided newborns); all other rows return exactly 1000000 (never cut)

decided_struct.description: one 49-col readout row per mask entry, computed client-side; width is validated against the bundle's read_struct (422 on drift)

edges_supersession.description: client-computed rel-4 pairs [old_src, new_dst] over `nodes` rows (same-file line overlap OR >=0.6 span-set Jaccard). The server sorts pairs lexicographically = the vendored emission order, keeping the scatter summation order bit-identical. Required, even when empty: the client must compute it consciously, never default it away.

scores_q.description: one per node row; rows outside mask are exactly 1000000 (never cut)

tau_q.description: the checkpoint's calibrated tau for the serving target_cov — constant per (ckpt, cov)

doom_q.description: sigmoid(doom head) on the 1e-6 grid — present iff the request carried gf, the checkpoint has a doom head, and a forward ran

embed.description: server-side embed wall time. Unlike v1 (always 0.0) this is a real number on v2 and is the primary capacity signal — it shares the serving lock with the forward (docs/server-side-embedding.md §6).

score_tools_request.description: POST /v1/score/tools with contract='brain-api/v2'. Schema nodes attach as task-conditioned causal SINKS (rel 3, task->schema only), exactly the trained attach_tools topology; xe rides the dev path's fp16 round-trip for bit-parity. `nodes` is the tool-spec chunk pipeline view (at step 0, mirror the dev fallback of chunking the task text — nodes must be non-empty).

tools.description: the deduped (last-wins) roster in order; [] returns the fail-open shape (names: []) = serve the full roster

names.description: echoes the request roster names, aligned with scores_q/tokens; [] = ineligible, serve full roster (fail-open)

tokens.description: echoes the request token masses (the prune ranking unit)

score_rules_request.description: POST /v1/score/rules with contract='brain-api/v2'. The rule ROSTER and rule TEXT live server-side (rules.json) and are server-embedded — unchanged from v1. `nodes` is the tool-spec chunk pipeline view. mask/decided_struct are decision-path fields the rule head never reads and are deliberately absent (the served model is extra='forbid' — sending them is a 422).

cur_step.description: the fire step; a step with no step node clamps to the nearest EARLIER step node

edges_supersession.description: client-computed rel-4 pairs over `nodes` rows (same semantics as score_trace_request). Required, even when empty.

score_rules_response.description: Identical shape on all three contracts.

scores_q.description: eid -> quantized raw sigmoid(score_rules); {} = ineligible/failed -> fail open

fire_step.description: echoes the requested fire step — the consumer's (eid, fire_step) dedupe key

rules.description: the scored roster at the CURRENT step, aligned with scores_q; [] on the fail-open path

tau_hint_q.description: ADVISORY ONLY — the firing tau MUST be bench-calibrated per checkpoint before any consumer fires on it

description.description: restates the advisory-tau caveat on every response

neighbors_request.description: POST /v1/neighbors with contract='brain-api/v2' — cross-trace neighbor cost baseline for the proxy's runaway signal. Called ONCE per conversation (the client caches the result in its conversation memo). The server embeds task_text and queries the hoods artifact. 409 on checkpoint mismatch like score/trace.

task_text.description: task statement text[:2000] — the anchor query over the hoods artifact; empty string -> zero vector -> nbr_count 0

nbr_cost_median.description: MEDIAN realized cost of the top-k (DASEIN_NEIGHBORS=16) nearest anchors carrying cost metadata; null when hoods are off or fewer than 4 costs were found — the runaway signal stays inert

nbr_count.description: how many neighbor cost samples were found
